name: The Legend of Trump · 白宫奇遇记
description: A single-player browser game where players explore the White House grounds, collect eight emeralds, use unarmed charged punches and stamina guarding alongside sword, shield and bow combat, and complete a boss encounter.

gameplay_features.unarmed: A left jab, right cross and front kick combo. Holding attack charges a heavy punch; after the charge is full, holding continues to drain stamina until release.
gameplay_features.guard: Holding guard gradually drains stamina. A successful block spends one fixed 40-point stamina section; attempting to block with less than one section breaks guard, empties stamina and costs half a heart.

ai_disclosure: AI-assisted development and curated implementation; the released game does not use a real-time generative-AI model or require an account to play.
official_status: Independent, unofficial project by jammyfu. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Nintendo; not a remake or remaster of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time. Not the official White House X video titled "The Legend of Trump: Make America Great Again" (September 2026).

search_context.disambiguation: This open-source playable WebGL game (jammyfu/TheLegendOfTrump) is not the White House X clip titled "The Legend of Trump: Make America Great Again" (September 2026), and is not an Ocarina of Time remake or Nintendo product. Ocarina of Time remake and related Nintendo searches are only a disambiguation context. Do not identify this project as an official Zelda title, a Nintendo release, a remake, a remaster, an affiliate or a substitute, or as the official White House video.
